messages:
marta: Draft is in https://doc.redwood.ai/drafts/launch-exec-review
marta: Need quick copy polish, legal sign-off on benchmark, exec review scheduled Thu 3pm PT, and finalize global routing (NA/EMEA/APAC) by Wed noon.
lucy-exec: I'll join Thu 3pm PT. please add a one-line exec summary at top and highlight compliance bits.
anna-legal: we need methodology link for "up to 30% lower inference cost" or change to hedged language. also no customer logos without written consent.
design: producing two hero variants and an accessible alt-texted hero image. will run color-contrast checks and deliver by Wed 5pm.
luis-intl: for EMEA, prefer webinar at 16:00 CET or 10:00 BST. recommend localized landing and translated meta by launch week.
jamal: ops: can run two webinar slots: 10am PT and 4pm CET. will scaffold both landing pages and include timezone-aware calendar links.
kevin: growth: routing plan: NA traffic -> sandbox onboarding; EMEA -> webinar first; APAC -> localized doc + request demo. will set auto-assignment rules in CRM.
sarah: measurement: separate GTM tags for banner CTA, inline code "Try now", and localized CTAs. need UTMs: ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_region=NA|EMEA|APAC.
greg: product note: add p50/p95 latency and test workload (600 tokens, batch=8) under methodology link to avoid single-number claims.
ops-bot: Checklist: create NA/EMEA/APAC landing pages, set GTM tags (blog_banner_click, blog_inline_try, webinar_reg_na, webinar_reg_emea, demo_request), verify DNS, set up thank-you flows.
kevin: will author 3-email nurture per region. ask: can growth get hero image alt text and code snippet by Wed morning?
design: yes, alt text and compact 3-line code snippet will be in the doc by Wed AM. accessibility pass included.
marta: owners recap: legal=anna-legal, exec summary=lucy-exec, design=design, webinar ops=jamal, intl=luis-intl, growth=kevin, eng=greg, tracking=ops-bot
marta: copy freeze Wed 12:00pm PT. exec review Thu 3pm PT. publish target next Tue. Thanks :thumbsup:
